title: ACOT computes ATAN(1/x) with a stored x87 reciprocal, adding pi for negative inputs and returning pi/2 at zero
statement: In Excel 16.0 build 20430, ACOT(0) returns pi/2 (0x3ff921fb54442d18) and nonzero inputs evaluate excel_atan_reduced(RN53(RN64(1/x))), adding pi when x < 0 and flushing subnormal results to +0. Storing the x87 reciprocal before the arctangent kernel is required to match all 16,924 full-bank ACOT rows.
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0 build 20430 Value2 probes in CalcFunc-Evidence (runs/w111-acot-heldout-20260929 and runs/w111-extended-numeric-20260929) and matched on 16,924/16,924 full-bank ACOT rows.
inferred: That the stored-x87 reciprocal plus excel_atan_reduced model holds across all binary64 inputs beyond the 16,924 recorded bank rows is inferred.
